articles.title: India shortlists three private firms to build next-gen stealth fighter jets
articles.summary: India's government is preparing to issue tenders to three private companies shortlisted for developing and manufacturing next-generation fighter jets under the Advanced Multirole Combat Aircraft (AMCA) program. This strategic initiative aims to significantly bolster indigenous defence production capabilities and enhance the Indian Air Force's operational strength, marking a crucial step towards self-reliance in advanced military aviation technology.

articles.title: Confirmed XIs: Battle for the top three at La Cerámica
articles.summary: The Spanish LaLiga season concludes today with an emotional final match at Estadio de la Cerámica. Villarreal faces Atlético de Madrid in a high-stakes clash. Both teams arrive level, ensuring a competitive end to the league campaign. This highly anticipated fixture marks the curtain call for Spain's top football division, a globally followed sporting event.

articles.title: Dev Kumar Meena Secures Gold, Pole Vaulters Set New Record
articles.summary: At the National Senior Athletics Federation Competition, Dev Kumar Meena clinched a gold medal in the pole vault. Notably, he and Kuldeep Kumar jointly set an impressive new national record in the event, highlighting outstanding performances. The competition, which also saw other athletes achieve common qualifying standards, underscores significant advancements in national athletics.

articles.title: Can an Indian run 100m in less than 10 seconds in near future?
articles.summary: Indian athletics eyes a breakthrough in the elusive sub-10-second 100m dash, a national ambition for decades. Recent resurgence, led by sprinter Gurindervir Singh, offers strong hope that India could finally achieve this coveted milestone. This marks a significant potential leap for national sports, promising to boost morale and inspire future track and field aspirants.

articles.title: Police busts terrorists' hideout in Jammu and Kashmir's Chandoosa; huge cache of explosives recovered
articles.summary: Baramulla Police, in a joint counter-terror operation, successfully busted a terrorist hideout in the Nilsar Kandi area. The operation led to the recovery of a significant cache of explosives, marking a crucial success against terrorism. This coordinated effort highlights ongoing vigilance and effectiveness in maintaining national security in Jammu and Kashmir.
